pages.text: The races are always foes of each other: wild zerg, terrans and protoss fight on sight. Your units are your allies, neutral to other players' units until struck.$(br2)Villagers and golems leave your units alone unless they attack the village.

The races keep apart: a pack, a claim or a nydus worm of one race never appears within 96 blocks of the wild of another — their bases, claims, buildings and guards. Waves, raids and drops are attacks and go where they are sent.
